questions.question: How were people chosen to live in Jerusalem?
options: By wealth, the richest taking the best homes
By age, the oldest families settling first
By lot, one out of ten, with others volunteering
By tribe, each clan keeping to its own quarter
questions.answer: By lot, one out of ten, with others volunteering
